correctness.rationale: The radial beta integral in the stipulated probability measure gives the moments h_r; angular projection onto each e_(k+j) yields the three weights, including h_j/√(h_(-k)h_(k+j)) when crossing zero. The operator is a unitary bilateral translation times a real diagonal, so its modulus has entries |d_k|. The nonnegative tail gives −b_r. Conjugation J of functions satisfies J A_j J=A_j*, so J C J=−C*, giving d_(n−m−k)=−d_k and the opposite tail. For n>m, direct substitution, including the two endpoints, gives equal products h_n/√(h_k h_(n−m−k)) at 0≤k≤n−m; the reverse order follows by adjoint. Independently, for ρ=α+1>0 the ratio h_(r+j)/h_r=∏_(l=1)^j (r+l)/(r+l+ρ) is strictly increasing in r. The logarithmic mixed difference is a sum over l=1,...,m of the integral from 0 to n of ρ/[(r+l+t)(r+l+t+ρ)] dt, giving positive leading term ρmn/r². The prefactor tends to one with O(1/r) error. Compactness and the sharp rearrangement follow from two such tails and only finitely many central entries; the t-level count is asymptotic to 2√(ρmn/t), without any monotonicity assumption on b_r. The p-series and logarithmic average then give exactly the stated constants.
residual_risks: Supporting floating-point checks were inspected, not executed; they are not a proof. The frozen theorem only guarantees a null block, not exact nullity or absence of coalescence of different reflected pairs. The limits hold with parameters fixed.

value.rationale: These are the simplest non-diagonal analytic/coanalytic harmonic Toeplitz commutators. The exact tails and central description distinguish finite crossings from both infinite harmonic sectors and identify a sharp borderline ideal and logarithmic coefficient, rather than just a qualitative failure of commutation or a decay upper bound.
residual_risks: The statement does not classify general symbols or prove a uniform joint limit in m,n,α. It claims no exact nullity refinement beyond its explicit block.
